notes: Adds an optional Wear OS companion to the Wear-enabled Android edition: scroll each day’s minutes, change dates, and type or dictate current or remembered activities. Watch notes are journaled offline and applied through guarded phone-ledger transactions after explicit Watch consent, with conflict review and durable acknowledgments. The F-Droid source preparation removes the optional Google Wear transport and native watch sources by exact reviewed hashes. Native builds and physical Galaxy Watch7 validation remain pending; store publication and official F-Droid acceptance remain pending.
